title: Father, Adored in Worlds Above
description: Father, Adored in Worlds Above in Tonic Solfa to UXBRIDGE, doh is E: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in the supplement of the 1866 edition of A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1866), as hymn 490, “The Lord's Prayer”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Long Metre (8.8.8.8), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to UXBRIDGE; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Fa-ther, a-dored in worlds a-bove! Thy glo-rious name be hal-lowed still; Thy king-dom come in truth and love; And earth, like heaven, o-bey Thy will.

lines: Thy glorious name be hallowed still;
Thy kingdom come in truth and love;
And earth, like heaven, obey Thy will.
Lord, make our daily wants Thy care;
Forgive the sins which we forsake;
In Thy compassion let us share,
Thine is the kingdom, Thine the power,

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1866.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1866); set to UXBRIDGE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
